summary: Crypto Co filed an 8-K reporting a $25,000 private placement of 8 million shares to Sinco International Investments at ~$0.003125/share via a Subscription Agreement under Reg D Rule 506(b). The deal includes a prepaid warrant for a future offering. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no acquisition, tender, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing serves as notice of unregistered equity issuance with customary representations and warranties. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexity. Watch for dilution, but no risk-arb angle.
